name.zh-Hant: 普利特維采湖群國家公園
name.zh-Hans: 普利特维采湖群国家公园

airspace.zh: 依普利特維采湖群國家公園的拍攝規定（依《國家公園保護與保存規則》，克羅埃西亞官方公報80/21），禁止使用遙控飛行器進行空中拍攝；使用遙控飛行器，也是拍攝申請被拒絕的理由之一。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: Under the park's filming protocol (based on the rules for the protection and preservation of Plitvice Lakes National Park, Official Gazette 80/21), remote-controlled aircraft for aerial filming are banned, and their use is a reason to refuse a filming request. Check the current rules before any real flight.

kozjak.note: Largest lake, 82 ha, 47 m deep (east bank, approximate)

tagline.zh-Hant: 1777年寫下的名字、克羅埃西亞第一座國家公園、1991年的衝突與遊客上限
tagline.en: A name first written in 1777, Croatia's first national park, Easter 1991 and a cap on visitors

zh: 十六座湖泊，一層層嵌在克羅埃西亞的山林裡，
這裡是普利特維采湖群國家公園。
en: Sixteen lakes are set in tiers among the forested hills of Croatia:
this is Plitvice Lakes National Park.

zh: 六世紀時阿瓦爾人來到這一帶，
之後克羅埃西亞人在這裡定居下來。
en: The Avars settled the region in the 6th century,
followed by the Croats, who stayed for good.

zh: 後來這裡成了軍事邊區，由邊防軍人守衛。
這片地區，一度被叫做「魔鬼的花園」。
en: Later it became part of the Military Frontier, guarded by frontiersmen.
The region was once called "the garden of the devil".

zh: 1777年，奧托察茨的神父武卡索維奇，
第一次在文件裡寫下「普利特維采」這個名字。
en: In 1777 Dominik Vukasović, the priest of Otočac,
first wrote the name "Plitvice" in a document.

zh: 這個名字，來自那些積了水的淺淺盆地。
1861年，大波利亞納蓋了第一處給旅人的住所。
en: The name comes from the shallow basins that filled with water.
In 1861 the first lodging for travellers was built at Velika Poljana.

zh: 1888年，為了迎接史蒂芬妮王儲妃來訪，
湖區第一次為觀光整理了步道。
en: In 1888 the lakes were first arranged for tourism,
for a visit by Crown Princess Stéphanie.

zh: 1893年，雅內切克成立了保護湖區的協會；
1898年，一座瀑布以捐出演唱會收入的歌手特爾尼娜命名。
en: In 1893 Gustav Janeček founded a society to preserve the lakes;
in 1898 a waterfall was named after the singer Milka Trnina, who donated concert proceeds.

zh: 1949年4月8日，這裡成為克羅埃西亞第一座國家公園，
最初面積約一萬九千四百七十四公頃。
en: On 8 April 1949 this became Croatia's first national park,
covering 19,474 hectares at first.

zh: 1962到1968年，許多部卡爾·邁小說改編的電影在這裡拍攝，
包括《銀湖寶藏》。
en: From 1962 to 1968 many films of Karl May's novels were shot here,
including Treasure of the Silver Lake.

zh: 普利特維采湖群列入世界遺產。
en: On 26 October 1979
the Plitvice Lakes were inscribed on the World Heritage List.

zh: 1991年3月31日復活節，這裡爆發了武裝衝突，
是克羅埃西亞獨立戰爭中第一次有人死亡的戰鬥。
en: On Easter Sunday, 31 March 1991, an armed clash broke out here,
the first fatal fight of the Croatian War of Independence.

zh: 警察約西普·約維奇在衝突中殉職，
在克羅埃西亞，他被視為這場戰爭的第一位犧牲者。
en: The police officer Josip Jović was killed in the clash;
in Croatia he is seen as the first casualty of the war.

zh: 戰爭期間，旅館被當成軍營；
1997年公園移出瀕危名單，面積也擴大到約兩萬九千六百公頃。
en: During the war the hotels were used as barracks.
In 1997 the park was removed from the List in Danger and enlarged to 29,630 hectares.

zh: 遊客從1998年的約三十五萬人，
增加到2017年的約一百七十萬人。
en: Visitor numbers rose from about 350,000 in 1998
to a record of about 1.7 million in 2017.

zh: 2018年，聯合國教科文組織因污染問題提出警告；
2019年起，夏季每天最多一萬兩千人入園。
en: In 2018 UNESCO warned the park over pollution;
since 2019 summer entry has been capped at 12,000 a day.

zh: 從魔鬼的花園、戰場，
到全世界遊客想看的湖泊，這裡一直在改變。
en: From the devil's garden and a battlefield
to lakes the whole world wants to see, this place has kept changing.

tagline.zh-Hant: 王儲妃的步道、以歌手命名的瀑布、銀幕上的西部片，與今天的參觀規定
tagline.en: A crown princess's paths, a waterfall named for a singer, westerns on screen and today's visiting rules

zh: 公園大約九成在利卡-塞尼縣，
另外一成在卡爾洛瓦茨縣。
en: About 90% of the park lies in Lika-Senj County,
the rest in Karlovac County.

zh: 湖區附近，有一座修道院建在古代亞波德人與羅馬人聚落的遺址上，
今天只剩下幾段牆。
en: A monastery was built near here on the remains of a Japod and Roman settlement;
only fragments of its walls survive.

zh: 中世紀時，蒙古人的侵襲威脅著居民；
後來茲林斯基與弗蘭科潘家族帶動了地方的復興。
en: In the Middle Ages Mongol raids threatened the people here;
later the Zrinski and Frankopan families led a recovery.

zh: 軍事邊區時代，逃難來的塞爾維亞東正教徒，
以服兵役換取這裡的土地。
en: In Military Frontier times Serb Orthodox refugees
were given land here in return for military service.

zh: 1888年，史蒂芬妮王儲妃來訪；
有兩條步道，以皇帝的女兒命名。
en: Crown Princess Stéphanie visited in 1888;
two paths are named after the Emperor's daughters.

zh: 1898年，歌劇歌手特爾尼娜把演唱會收入捐給湖區，
一座瀑布因此以她的名字命名。
en: In 1898 the opera singer Milka Trnina gave her concert proceeds to the lakes,
and a waterfall was named after her.

zh: 1926年，植物學家佩瓦萊克，
最早主張要保護普利特維采。
en: In 1926 the botanist Ivo Pevalek
was among the first to argue for protecting Plitvice.

zh: 1943年6月14日，克羅埃西亞的反法西斯委員會，
在普利特維采召開了成立會議。
en: On 14 June 1943 ZAVNOH, the anti-fascist council of Croatia,
held its founding session at Plitvice.

zh: 1960年代，德國作家卡爾·邁的西部小說，
在這些湖泊和瀑布前被搬上銀幕。
en: In the 1960s the western novels of the German writer Karl May
were filmed in front of these lakes and waterfalls.

zh: 1980年代，南斯拉夫的觀光蓬勃發展，
普利特維采是熱門的目的地。
en: Tourism boomed in Yugoslavia in the 1980s,
and Plitvice was a favourite destination.

zh: 今天公園全年開放，
有七條遊覽路線和四條登山步道。
en: Today the park is open all year,
with seven tour routes and four hiking trails.

zh: 2006年起，湖裡禁止游泳與戲水，
以保護湖水與石灰華。
en: Since 2006 bathing and swimming in the lakes have been banned
to protect the water and the travertine.

zh: 夏天的尖峰日，每個入口每小時最多進六百五十人，
整天最多一萬兩千人。
en: On busy summer days each entrance admits at most 650 people an hour,
and no more than 12,000 a day.

zh: 公園的拍攝規定明文禁止
用遙控飛行器進行空中拍攝。
en: The park's filming rules expressly ban
remote-controlled aircraft for aerial filming.

zh: 王儲妃、歌手、電影與戰爭，
都在這些湖邊留下了足跡。
en: A princess, a singer, films and a war
have all left their footprints by these lakes.

title.en: Lakes Made by Forest and Moss

tagline.zh-Hant: 約一千四百種植物、六十種蘭花、五百多年的冷杉，與棕熊、狼和猞猁
tagline.en: About 1,400 plants, 60 orchids, a fir over 500 years old, and bears, wolves and lynx

zh: 森林覆蓋了公園大約百分之八十一的面積，
其中將近九成五是山毛櫸。
en: Forest covers about 81% of the park,
and beech makes up nearly 95% of it.

zh: 公園西北部的喬爾科瓦灣，
有一片八十四公頃的老齡林。
en: In the north-west of the park, Čorkova uvala
holds 84 hectares of old-growth forest.

zh: 那裡有一棵超過五百歲的歐洲銀冷杉，
高五十八公尺，直徑一百五十公分。
en: There stands a European silver fir over 500 years old,
58 metres tall and 150 cm across.

zh: 公園記錄到約一千四百種植物與亞種，
大約是克羅埃西亞全國的三成。
en: About 1,400 plant species and subspecies have been recorded,
some 30% of Croatia's total.

zh: 這裡有大約六十種蘭花，
和兩百零七種苔蘚。
en: There are about 60 orchid species
and 207 species of moss.

zh: 湖水裡的苔蘚與藻類，
幫助碳酸鈣沉積，堆成石灰華的堤壩。
en: Mosses and algae in the water
help calcium carbonate settle, building travertine barriers.

zh: 這些堤壩每年最多可長高十三公釐；
一道道堤壩，把河水擋成了一座座湖。
en: These barriers can grow up to 13 mm higher each year;
barrier by barrier, they hold the water back into lakes.

zh: 科濟亞克湖的湖底，
每年大約累積零點八公釐的沉積物。
en: On the bed of Lake Kozjak
about 0.8 mm of sediment builds up each year.

zh: 森林裡住著棕熊、狼和歐亞猞猁。
這三種大型肉食動物，都還在這裡生活。
en: Brown bears, wolves and Eurasian lynx live in the forests,
all three large carnivores still at home here.

zh: 公園記錄到一百六十八種鳥
和二十二種蝙蝠。
en: 168 bird species
and 22 bat species have been recorded.

zh: 湖裡有九種魚，
公園裡還有十四種兩棲類與十三種爬蟲類。
en: There are nine species of fish in the lakes,
and the park has 14 amphibian and 13 reptile species.

zh: 公園的主要壓力，來自過度興建觀光設施、
污水處理，以及從科濟亞克湖取水。
en: The main pressures on the park are excessive building for tourism,
wastewater treatment and water drawn from Lake Kozjak.

zh: 國際自然保護聯盟2025年的評估，
把這裡的保育前景評為「良好，但有些隱憂」。
en: IUCN's 2025 assessment
rated the outlook here "good with some concerns".

zh: 公園有八成以上的面積，
屬於嚴格保護區。
en: More than 80% of the park
is a zone of strict conservation.

zh: 森林、苔蘚與流水，
一起慢慢地造出了這些湖。
en: Forest, moss and running water
have slowly built these lakes together.

tagline.zh-Hant: 白雲岩上的上湖、石灰岩峽谷裡的下湖、133公尺的落差與78公尺的大瀑布
tagline.en: Twelve upper lakes on dolomite, four lower lakes in a limestone canyon, a 133 m drop and a 78 m waterfall

zh: 十六座有名字的湖，從南向北一路往下排列。
第一座到最後一座湖，高度相差一百三十三公尺。
en: Sixteen named lakes step down from south to north;
from the first to the last the drop is 133 metres.

zh: 最上面的普羅錢斯科湖，海拔約六百三十九公尺，
最深約三十七公尺。
en: The topmost, Lake Prošćansko, lies at about 639 metres
and is up to 37 metres deep.

zh: 十二座上湖，位在白雲岩上，
一座接著一座，往科濟亞克湖流去。
en: The twelve Upper Lakes lie on dolomite,
each flowing on into the next towards Lake Kozjak.

zh: 加洛瓦茨湖海拔約六百公尺，
湖水從石灰華堤壩上，一層層溢流下去。
en: Lake Galovac lies at about 600 metres,
its water spilling tier by tier over travertine barriers.

zh: 再往下，就是最大的科濟亞克湖，
面積八十二公頃，最深四十七公尺。
en: Further down lies the largest, Lake Kozjak,
82 hectares in area and 47 metres deep.

zh: 湖泊的面積，
加起來還不到公園的百分之一。
en: All the lakes together
cover less than 1% of the park.

zh: 四座下湖，在一道石灰岩的峽谷裡，
米拉諾瓦茨、加瓦諾瓦茨、卡盧傑羅瓦茨與諾瓦科維查布羅德。
en: The four Lower Lakes lie in a limestone canyon:
Milanovac, Gavanovac, Kaluđerovac and Novakovića Brod.

zh: 峽谷旁，普利特維察溪從崖頂落下，
形成高七十八公尺的大瀑布。
en: Beside the canyon the Plitvica stream drops off the cliff
as the Great Waterfall, 78 metres high.

zh: 下湖在薩斯塔夫奇瀑布結束，
科拉納河就從瀑布底下流出。
en: The Lower Lakes end at the Sastavci waterfalls,
where the Korana River springs from beneath them.

zh: 公園最低點在科拉納河橋，海拔三百六十七公尺；
最高點是塞利什基峰，一千兩百七十九公尺。
en: The lowest point of the park is at the Korana bridge, 367 metres;
the highest is Seliški vrh, 1,279 metres.

zh: 公園的面積約兩百九十七平方公里，
2000年，世界遺產範圍又擴大了一萬多公頃。
en: The park covers about 297 square kilometres;
in 2000 the World Heritage Site was enlarged by over 10,000 hectares.

zh: 石灰華的形成，
正是這裡被列為世界遺產的「傑出普世價值」。
en: The forming of travertine
is the "outstanding universal value" for which the park is listed.

zh: 整個公園從最低點到最高點，
高低差達到九百一十二公尺。
en: From its lowest to its highest point
the park spans a difference in height of 912 metres.

zh: 除了十六座有名字的湖，
還有好幾座沒有名字的小湖。
en: Besides the sixteen named lakes
there are several smaller, unnamed ones.

zh: 十六座湖，像一道長長的階梯，
由水和石灰華一階一階地蓋起來。
en: Sixteen lakes form a long staircase,
built step by step by water and travertine.
